summary.text: Spindle 3 temperature reached 64.2 against the 60.0 validated limit (4.2 over), critical alert, status open. Lot TM-HS12-261120-206 has 3 parts at risk. Recommend QA hold, NCR, CMM inspection of those parts and a maintenance request.

quarantine.rationale: The rule requires quarantining parts machined outside the validated limit. The lot row lists these 3 of 15 parts as at risk and 12 as releasable. QA should confirm that split against the DHR before any release.

cmm_inspection.scope: CMM the 3 at-risk parts for stem taper and neck geometry, the risk named in the rule, before they go to clean/passivate. No CMM results exist yet. QA decides whether to extend the scope to the other parts of the lot.

ncr.rationale: The rule requires an NCR for parts machined outside the validated limit (PS-TM-MILL-HS-003 rev C). The alert row gives NCR id NCR-20261120-171005-F09D if opened. A qualified person must open and sign it.

maintenance_request.rationale: Spindle 3 temperature rose to 64.2 and the last reading bucket was still above 60 (minimum 61.0). The last spindle inspection on the same component was 2026-09-01. Recommend a spindle and thermal compensation check against OQ-TM-CNC1-014.

risk_narrative.text: The model risk score is 87% (model version 3, synthetic). The largest contributors are the 5-minute spindle temperature slope (0.41) and vibration RMS (0.22). The score supports the hold but does not replace CMM results. Projected right-first-time is 0% (3 of 3 parts started are at risk).

steps.action: Review and sign a quarantine of lot TM-HS12-261120-206 for the 3 at-risk parts listed in the disposition. Keep them out of clean/passivate and sterile pack until CMM is complete.
Open the NCR for the excursion (id given in the alert row: NCR-20261120-171005-F09D). Record 64.2 against the 60.0 limit and the lot DHR ref DHR-TM-HS12-261120-206.
Request CMM inspection of the 3 quarantined parts for stem taper and neck geometry. Compare against the drawing tolerances and record the results in the NCR.
Request a Spindle 3 check on CNC-1: thermal behaviour, cooling and bearings, and re-verification of thermal compensation per OQ-TM-CNC1-014. The last inspection was 2026-09-01.

Review the excursion trend (readings peaked at 64.2, then 63.1) and the model drivers (temperature slope, vibration). Assess impact against PQ-TM-HS12-022 and PS-TM-MILL-HS-003 rev C before Spindle 3 resumes cutting.
Hold further Spindle 3 production on CNC-1 until QA and Maintenance agree it is back inside the validated limit. Alert history was unavailable at grounding, so confirm the current status.

data.definition: Projected right-first-time = (parts started - parts at risk) / parts started, over the lots an excursion touched. Parts at risk are the parts whose cut overlapped the time Spindle 3 was outside its validated limit. Projected: no CMM results exist yet.

data.required_action: QA hold: quarantine parts machined outside the validated limit, open an NCR and send them to CMM
data.risk: Dimensional nonconformance: stem taper and neck geometry

data.notes: Spindle bearing inspection; thermal compensation re-verified per OQ-TM-CNC1-014
